$comment: Licence policy for every committed or shipped asset (NOTES.md §14). Keys are SPDX ids, or LicenseRef-* where SPDX has none. 'allow' = fine as is; 'note' = allowed only with a non-empty licence_note on the record explaining the case-by-case decision; anything else (including unknown ids) fails the audit. 'share_alike' marks licences that force derived assets to carry the same licence. 'attribution' marks licences that need a CREDITS.md line.

LicenseRef-Own-Synthesis.$comment: Generated by our own code; ships under the project asset licence (CC-BY-4.0).

LicenseRef-PDM-1.0.$comment: Public Domain Mark is a label, not a waiver. On radio aporee it is an uploader choice for recent recordings, so treat it like CC0 only after a human accepts it; credit the recordist anyway.
